from griffe.loader import GriffeLoader
from griffe.extensions import Extension
from griffe.dataclasses import Function
from griffe.docstrings.docstring import Docstring

class CheckedExtension(Extension):
    """Extension that appends ' [checked]' to function docstrings."""
    
    def on_object_collected(self, griffe, obj):
        """Called when an object is collected."""
        if isinstance(obj, Function):
            if obj.docstring is None:
                obj.docstring = Docstring(" [checked]")
            else:
                obj.docstring.value += " [checked]"

# Aggregate extensions as griffe expects
extensions = [CheckedExtension()]

# Load package through module-level load entry point
loader = GriffeLoader(extensions=extensions)
package = loader.load("mypkg")

print(f"Successfully loaded package: {package.name}")
